testName: Tiered Volume Discount Schedules Calculation Check
steps:
1. Open Quotes tab
2. Open recent Draft Quote
3. Click on "Edit Lines" button
4. In Quote Line Editor, locate Product "Enterprise License"
5. Change Quantity from 5 to 50 units
6. Click on "Calculate" button
7. Verify Unit Price drops from $100 to $80 reflecting Tier 2 Volume Discount Schedule (20% off)
8. Verify Net Total recalculates dynamically to $4,000
